seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina must sit directly next to Päivikki in the front row. Left-to-right order of the two is not yet specified and must be confirmed with the client. The other front-row occupants are not yet specified. Ask AV about a hearing loop or receiver, and check chapel acoustics and step-free access.

photographer: TBD: alternative to Lumière Fotografia (client instruction: do not book or approach them). 2-3 quotes and date availability are pending.
venue_notes: DATE UNCONFIRMED: 12 Sept 2026 is a Saturday, but the system clock shows 13 Oct 2026, after that date. No binding bookings or deposits until the client confirms the date and year. Only non-binding enquiries and quotes are allowed.

Budget total is 0 because no quotes have been received yet. The hard cap is EUR 42,000 all in (VAT, service, shuttles, corkage, overtime), with a 5-8% contingency to keep. If cuts are needed, fireworks go before the interpreter. The order of the other optional items (flowers, photo booth, late bar) is not yet decided.
Confirm with the quinta whether the 96 guests include the couple, children, vendors and Päivikki.
Children's meal count is unknown (shown as 0 as a placeholder). It is an open question with the client.

Strictly NO nuts anywhere, including almonds in the cake (a nephew carries an EpiPen). Get written nut-free confirmation, cross-contamination controls and allergen labelling from the caterer and cake maker. Cover the bar, canapés, petit fours and favours. No outside food. The 11 vegetarian dishes must also be nut-free. Ask the quinta for the nearest emergency contact and route.

Proposed (not fixed) timings: vendors on site 14:30 with chapel mic sound check; guests arrive 15:15; speeches and first dance about 21:30; nut-free cake about 22:00; shuttle loops from 23:00. The ceremony may run up to about 60 minutes.

Ceremony is in Spanish and Finnish with consecutive or simultaneous interpreting still to be decided. Ask AV/DJ for a wireless mic for Päivikki, a sound check, whether the officiant needs a second mic, and receiver equipment if simultaneous.

Heat fallback: if the forecast is over 32C, cocktails move to the wine cellar. Confirm cellar capacity for 96 standing with bar and canapés, access, the decision point (for example 48h before) and who calls it. Brief the caterer, DJ and photographer.
Late ceremony: shorten cocktails, never the ceremony. Keep dinner at 19:30 where possible. Brief the caterer and photographer.
Fireworks: check whether they are booked and whether the quinta permits them.
Pimienta the dog is the ring bearer. Tell the quinta and ask about pet policy, chapel rules and fees. Who handles the dog is an open question.
Menu cards: get printer quotes with and without Finnish, plus the last order date. Finnish is added only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm.
DJ: put the Macarena ban in writing in the contract and brief.
Transport: get quotes for hotel-quinta shuttles for 96 guests, last departure 01:30, including accessible transport for Aino-Kaarina.

Open client questions: confirmed date and year; number and ages of children; RSVP count and deadline for Eero's family; ceremony duration and interpreting format; fireworks status; who looks after the nephew; Aino-Kaarina's mobility needs.
